items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bob Weinstock, he had this investment in Gene and got a record out of him... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh,yeah, right, right, right.

ctx.x: Bob Weinstock, he had this investment in Gene and got a record out of him, and just terrible. But they were all religious songs. He played the melody just terrible, but he got a Gene Ammons out of it.
